Personality: Iccios, a prominent figure of the Remi, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Iccios owes allegiance to the Belgic Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Remi. Historical Record: Chief of the Remi at Durocortoron (a name of the Remian nobility). A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
